<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def ncount(f): return sum(1 for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
def floodtop(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n'); return next((r for r in range(64) if 'p' in a[r]),None)
def clear_wave():
    cs=[]
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cc=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            cs.append(((min(rs)+max(rs))//2,(min(cc)+max(cc))//2))
    acts=[{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c} for r,c in cs]
    action(acts); return len(cs)
for i in range(16):
    nc=ncount(current_frame); ft=floodtop(current_frame)
    print(i,"step",current_frame.step,"N",nc,"ft",ft)
    if last_action_result.get('game_over') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print("ENDED"); break
    if nc>0:
        k=clear_wave(); print("CLEARED",k,"now step",current_frame.step,"N",ncount(current_frame)); break
    if ft is not None and ft<40:
        print("DANGER ft",ft); break
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':40,'col':30}])
print("final step",current_frame.step,"N",ncount(current_frame),"ft",floodtop(current_frame),"lvl",current_frame.level)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
